Book correction: In the fourth term the book prints n(n-1)n-2): a bracket is missing. The numerator is the product n(n-1)(n-2): + \dfrac{n(n-1)(n-2)}{3!}\left(\dfrac{1}{n}\right)^{3} + \dots

Book correction: In this line the book writes the limit as x \to +\infty. There is no x in the expression; the variable is n, so it should read: \therefore \lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1+\dfrac{1}{n}\right)^{n}
